findings.title: Secret exposed to the browser
findings.message: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_SECRET is bundled into client code
findings.remediation: Keep the secret on the server and expose a backend endpoint instead.

findings.title: No automated tests detected
findings.message: No test files or test directories found
findings.remediation: Add a test runner (Jest/Vitest, PHPUnit/Pest) and cover the critical paths.

findings.title: Next.js Content-Security-Policy not configured
findings.remediation: Return a Content-Security-Policy header from headers() in next.config.js or middleware.

findings.title: No CI workflow
findings.remediation: Add a pipeline (for example GitHub Actions) that runs tests and `devshield scan`.

findings.title: Production source maps enabled
findings.message: Source maps are generated for production
findings.remediation: Disable source maps for production builds or upload them to an error tracker.

findings.title: Unoptimized images
findings.remediation: Compress or convert to WebP/AVIF, and use next/image in Next.js projects.
